title: Age of the Last Credit Review and Step Points (Commercial Credit Account)
content:
How long ago a Commercial Credit Account was last reviewed adds percentage points to **the step percentage used** on a permanent increase.

### Clause

The step percentage used gains ten percentage points when the account's last credit review date is twenty-four or more whole months before today, five points when it is twelve to twenty-three whole months before today, and none otherwise.

Whole months between a date and today are the difference in calendar months, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than that date's day of the month, with no move of a month-end date to a shorter month's last day.

| Whole months since the last credit review date | Points |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | 10 |
| 12 to 23 | 5 |
| fewer than 12 | 0 |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, today 5 March)

- Last review 5 March two years earlier: 24 whole months, 10 points.
- Last review 6 March two years earlier: 23 whole months, 5 points.
- Last review 6 March of the previous year: 11 whole months, no points.
